title: Verify: Typed event bus delivery unit tests
summary: Unit tests for subscribe, unsubscribe, clear and no phaser import.
acceptance_criteria: Given emit objectClick, Then the listener gets the payload once.
Given unsubscribe, Then no further calls.

steps.action: Add tests: (1) phaserToReact.on('objectClick', fn); emit('objectClick',{id:'bookshelf'}); expect fn toHaveBeenCalledWith({id:'bookshelf'}) once; (2) call the returned unsubscribe, emit again, expect still one call; (3) subscribe on reactToPhaser 'transitionTo', call clear(), emit, expect no call; (4) read src/phaser/events.ts with node:fs and assert it does not contain "from 'phaser'".
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts
